title: Datacenter Buildouts and Brazilian Equities
summary: Datacenter spending, bond yields and Brazilian equity risk.
assessment: The most testable call worked: a left-wing runoff victory was followed by a sharp Brazilian selloff. The local yield-peak call also received near-term support. The long-term Brazil thesis remains open, while the explanation of SLR reform confuses leverage capital with risk-weighted capital.

claims.claim: AI investment crowds out other borrowers.
claims.reason: Competing demand can raise financing costs, but construction divergence does not identify a causal crowding-out effect. Treasury advisers subsequently reported no evidence of crowding out Treasury or nontechnology borrowing; physical resources, financing and policy effects should be tested separately.

evidence.finding: Committee presentation found no evidence yet of crowding out Treasury or nontechnology borrowing.

claims.claim: Reserve purchases slowed without becoming stimulus.
claims.reason: The New York Fed explicitly framed purchases as reserve management, with higher initial purchases ahead of April tax flows. Assets rose only about $47.6bn from April 29 to October 7 and were nearly flat thereafter. The operational distinction is supported; it does not prove purchases have no market effects.

claims.claim: SLR relief changes risk-weighted Treasury treatment.
claims.reason: This conflates separate capital constraints. The supplementary leverage ratio is a non-risk-based backstop; reducing its requirement is not a change in Treasury risk weights. A relevant e SLR reform had already been finalized in November 2025 and taken effect in April 2026, though additional future changes remain possible.

claims.claim: Brazil combines high real rates with external buffers.
claims.reason: The central bank confirms a 13.75% policy rate. Official balance-of-payments data distinguish the goods surplus from the current-account deficit, correcting an earlier report’s conflation. Nominal policy rate minus trailing inflation is an ex-post shortcut, not the expected real return of a foreign investor; reserve adequacy needs short-term obligations and currency composition.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: A conditional election forecast can be resolved separately from the long-term investment thesis.
Specify which capital constraint is binding before predicting the effect of regulatory relief.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
